text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Government orders all university students to report to campuses by September 26 or forfeit the current academic session.
- Internal report reveals 2,500 ghost workers at Ministry of Works.
- More than 200,000 tonnes of super steel concentrates are rusting at Itakpe because there is no rail link to convey them to Delta Steel Company, southern Nigeria, for processing.
- Report indicts Nigerian law enforcement agencies for abusing people on business trips from neighbouring countries, in contravention of Economic Community of West African States' protocols.
- Police declare security alert in northern city of Kaduna, over an ultimatum given by a Shi'ite Moslem group after the arrest of its leader.
- Deputy central bank governor berates banks for failing to assist farmers with credit facilities.
- Six new states are likely to be added to the current 30, sources close to the presidency say.
